title: Control threads jot — SOC2 prep hypotheses
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratch for mapping controls -> owners -> evidence ideas. Not polished. Use this to drive next meeting with Evan/Maya and to seed the control evidence tracker (confluence link above).

High-level hypotheses (tl;dr):
- Hypothesis A: Most logical ownership for access provisioning controls will live split between platform-engineering (API keys, console auth) and security (IAM policies, periodic review). Need an explicit owner for Hosted API key lifecycle (rotation, revocation logs).
- Hypothesis B: For Dedicated/Private offerings, the strongest evidence will be architecture diagrams + infra-as-code manifests showing network separation (VPC subnets, route tables). Current docs are fragmented across infra repo and customer onboarding playbooks.
- Hypothesis C: Operational change controls (deploy approvals, rollbacks) need lightweight evidence generated from CI/CD traces — we can stitch GitHub Actions runs + deployment tags + canary rollback events.

Control mapping DRAFT (control-ish lines to flesh out):
- CC: Logical access — Owner: platform-engineering + security
  Evidence examples: IAM role change PRs (GH PRs), CloudTrail / audit logs, admin console access logs, API key create/delete events
  Test idea: pick 5 users and validate their change history in CloudTrail during a 90-day window; confirm approval PR existed for each elevated role.
  Open questions: do private deployments emit the same centralized audit events? For on-prem must request customer-provided logs — need a standard evidence template.

- CC: System configuration/change management — Owner: release-engineering
  Evidence: change tickets (JIRA INFRA-314), deploy manifest diffs, canary experiment logs in console, rollback events recorded in deploy tool
  Test idea: show 3 recent release windows with corresponding deploy manifests & post-deploy verification checks.

- CC: Data retention & deletion for user-provided data (hosted) — Owner: product-hosted-api + privacy
  Evidence: retention policy doc, DB TTL config (schema + migration PR), retention job runs (logs), sample deletion request handled end-to-end
  Risks: edge-case around embeddings cache on Dedicated if customer pins model with cached prefixes. Need explicit policy note: cached KV for <retention period> and manual purge flow.

- CC: Availability & incident response — Owner: site-reliability-engineering
  Evidence: incident postmortems (SRE channel), SLA monitoring graphs, runbook references, PagerDuty incident exports
  Test: validate 2 incident PMs and confirm remedial actions were implemented (link commits).

- CC: Vendor management (subservice orgs) — Owner: security + procurement
  Evidence: vendor questionnaires, signed DPA, continuous monitoring notes
  Unclear: which open-source components qualify as "vendor" for SOC2 evidence? Will auditors accept OSS SBOM + internal dependency scanning? Likely need to include OSS risk note.

Risk register / notable gaps (quick):
- G1: Private/on-prem evidence heterogeneity — severity: high. Action: create "evidence checklist for private deployments" template, ask Solutions Eng to fill during onboarding (owner: solutions-engineering).
- G2: API key rotation proof — severity: medium. We have logs for create/delete but not an automated rotation ledger. Action: propose a lightweight rotation job with persistent rotation events (owner: platform-eng).
- G3: Temporary shared credentials used in support triage — severity: medium-high. Hard to track unless we centralize ephemeral access (recommend: short-lived SSO tokens + audit wrapper).
- G4: Snapshot of data encryption in transit for Dedicated customer networks — severity: low-medium. Need architecture snippet showing TLS config + load balancer termination point.

Evidence generation ideas (quick hackable):
- Use GH Actions to export deploy artifacts: capture commit -> tag -> deploy run -> snyk/vuln scan -> release notes. Keep a small script to assemble a tester-friendly artifact zip for auditors.
- For access logs: glue together CloudTrail + internal admin console logs into a single queryable BigQuery view. If time-constrained, export CSV samples for the audit window.
- For private/on-prem: build a one-page "evidence binder" template (yaml) that customers can populate with their own logs/PKI info.

Meeting notes / context (from quick convo 2026-03-04):
- Evan: wants a short list of 10 must-have artifacts we can produce in 2 weeks.
- Maya: we should prioritize Hosted evidence first; Dedicated/private can be templated.
- I flagged the API key rotation gap — Evan said open to a small infra ticket to emit explicit rotation events.

Immediate next actions (my todo):
- [ ] Draft the "evidence binder" template and drop in confluence (due 2026-03-10).
- [ ] Create INFRA ticket for rotation-event ledger (assign to @evan) — link once created.
- [ ] Pull 90-day CloudTrail sample for 5 admin users and annotate (use case for access-control test).
- [ ] Sync with Solutions Eng to capture private onboarding checklist (set meeting w/ Maia from SE).

Open questions to raise in audit prep sync: (for checklist)
1) Will auditors accept combined CSV + PR links as evidence or do they require native console exports?
2) For Dedicated deployments, are we expected to provide customer logs or a statement that customer controls them? (We need a formal template either way.)
3) Do we need to maintain retention logs for embeddings/cache? If yes, need policy + purge flow documented.

Other random notes / thoughts:
- Might be worth a small "SOC2 quick-win" sprint (1 week) focused on: evidence binder, rotation ledger, 3 PMs/Incidents + artifacts. Label as "SOC2 quick-win" in backlog to make it visible to eng leads.
- Keep an eye on telemetry privacy: metric-level aggregates are ok, but retention of telemetry trace details that include user prompt content could be sensitive — product needs to confirm what telemetry is stored and anonymization policy.

References / crumbs for later:
- Confluence: SEC SOC2 prep (linked above).
- JIRA: INFRA-314 (deploy trace export), SEC-457 (evidence gaps).
- Slack: #trust-ops thread (search: "private evidence template")

If anyone reading this has quick wins they've already used in past audits, paste them here. This is intentionally messy — I want to capture threads before the sync.

-- Zoe
(quick snapshot — follow-up meeting 2026-03-08)
